title: Protolabs HQ site layout from Hennepin County 2026 aerial
attribution: Hennepin County GIS — Imagery/UTM_Aerial_2026 MapServer; visual tracing by reconstruction author
precision_note: Coordinates rounded to 0.1 px only for data handling; actual uncertainty typically 2–5 m and larger under tree shadows. This is a visual reconstruction aid, not survey/site engineering data. Parking counts and trees are approximate.
rendering_notes: Main asphalt envelopes intentionally extend beneath buildings: GIS footprints/building mesh should overlay them.
Render grass and rock polygons slightly above asphalt. Use GIS terrain elevation rather than assuming physical flatness from this trace.
Water boundary follows visible dark open water; marsh/vegetation and shadows can obscure shoreline.
Parking row endpoints are estimated car centerlines. Convert bay_depth_px to ground scale; row-count estimates should not be presented as official capacity.
Tree centers approximate crowns/trunks; do not use long northwest shadows as canopies. Seasonal leaf-off imagery does not establish species.

East lot is mostly empty in reference. Use row suggested_aerial_occupancy_fraction to avoid filling all 660 inferred positions with cars. Capacity estimate is rough, includes uncertain strips and is not official.

polygons.notes: Outer envelope for connected HQ lots and north service apron. Overlay GIS building footprint to cover pavement under building; overlay grass islands below. Boundary under trees/shadows inferred.
Main road, west bulb and south-running branch included as one approximate outline. Tree shadows and driveway mouths softened.
Neighbor building footprint must overlay this envelope. Far west boundary is image-clipped.
South neighbor pavement envelope; include GIS footprint above it.
Envelope beneath multiple south-eastern neighboring footprints; grass overlays should reduce flat paving.
